description: Small hot pepper, about 2.5 x 7.5cm, medium spiciness. Can be harvested green (when the fruit is younger and milder) or left on the plant longer until it turns red and becomes hotter and sweeter.
sowing_method: Direct seed indoors, harden seedlings off before transplanting outside.

data_sources.notes: growth_habit='spreading' - Trefle growth_habit='Subshrub, Forb/herb' includes Shrub/Subshrub
